title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
english: Pope Leo XIV recently visited the remote Andean village of Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, a place where he served as a bishop for several years. During an outdoor mass, he addressed the hardships faced by the local community, specifically highlighting poverty, the struggle of migration, and declining populations. The Pope expressed his emotional connection to the area and encouraged the residents to remain hopeful despite the significant socioeconomic challenges facing the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በቅርቡ በፔሩ ወደሚገኘው የሳንታ ክሩዝ ደ ሱቻባምባ ገጠራማ መንደር ተጉዘዋል። ጳጳሱ ቀደም ሲል ለብዙ ዓመታት በቆዩበት በዚህ ስፍራ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ በድህነት፣ በስደት እና በሕዝብ ቁጥር መቀነስ ምክንያት ለሚሰቃዩት የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ያላቸውን አጋርነት ገልጸዋል። በችግሮች ውስጥም ቢሆን ተስፋ እንዳይቆርጡ ነዋሪዎቹን አበረታተዋል።
oromo: Pappasii Liyo 14ffaan yeroo dhihoo kana biyya Peru keessatti gara baadiyaa Santa Kruuz de Suuchaabaambaa deemanii jiru. Bakka kanaan dura waggoota hedduuf biyya bulchaa turan sanatti, haasawaa godhaniin hiyyummaa, godaansaa fi hir'ina baay'ina ummataa rakkoolee hawaasichaa ta'anirratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Pappasichi rakkoolee jiran hunda keessattuu ummatni abdii akka hin kunne isaan jajjabeessaniiru.

title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
english: A federal judge has issued a temporary order preventing the Trump administration from closing the historic East Potomac Golf Links in Washington DC for renovations. The judge ruled that the government violated federal laws and failed to justify the closure of this public parkland. This decision halts the proposed improvements until at least November 28th, keeping the golf course open while legal challenges continue.
amharic: የፌዴራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኘውን ታሪካዊ የጎልፍ ሜዳ ለማደስ ብሎ የዘጋውን እገዳ ለጊዜው አግደዋል። ዳኛዋ መንግሥት የፌዴራል ሕጎችን እንደጣሰ እና የሕዝብ ፓርኩን ለመዝጋት የቀረበው ምክንያት በቂ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ እስከ ህዳር 28 ድረስ የጎልፍ ሜዳው እንዲከፈት የሚያደርግ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በሕግ አግባብ እስኪጣራ ድረስ ሥራው እንዲቆም አዟል።
oromo: Abbaan murtiin federalaa tokko bulchiinsi Trump dirree golfii seena-qabeessa Washington DC jiru akka hin cufne ajaja yeroo dabarsaniiru. Abbaan murtichaa mootummaan seera federalaa cabsuusaa fi iddoo kana cufuuf sababni dhiyeesse gahaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Murteen kun hanga guyyaa 28 Sadaasaatti hojii haaromsaa kan dhaabu yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun seeraan hanga ilaalamuutti dirreen golfichaa akka banamee turu godha.

title: Italian artist reimagines Madonna paintings to expose Gaza’s pain
english: Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has created an installation called 'Holy Mothers of Gaza' in a Naples chapel. The artwork features traditional Madonna paintings that conceal real photographs of Gaza taken by journalist Omar El Qattaa beneath their surface. This project aims to use classical religious imagery to highlight the suffering currently experienced by people in Gaza.
amharic: ጣሊያናዊው አርቲስት ኤድዋርዶ ካስታዶ በኔፕልስ በሚገኝ ቤተ-ክርስቲያን ውስጥ 'የጋዛ ቅዱሳን እናቶች' የተሰኘ አዲስ የጥበብ ስራ አቅርቧል። የጥበብ ስራው ባህላዊ የድንግል ማርያም ምስሎችን በመጠቀም፣ ከስራቸው ደግሞ በጋዜጠኛ ኦማር ኤል ቀታ የተነሱ የጋዛ እውነተኛ ፎቶግራፎችን ይዟል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት የሃይማኖታዊ ጥበብ ስራዎችን በመጠቀም በጋዛ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ስቃይ ለዓለም ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Artistii biyya Xaaliyaanii Edoardo Castaldo jedhamu, mana sagadaa Nepples keessatti 'Haadholii Qulqulluu Gaza' jedhuun hojii ogummaa tokko agarsiiseera. Hojiin kun, fakkiiwwan Maariyaam kan aadaa ta'an kan gubbaa isaanii irraa saaqaman yoo ta'u, jala isaa immoo suuraawwan dhugaa kan gaazexeessaa Omaar El Qattaa Gaza keessatti kaase agarsiisa. Kaayyoon hojii kanaa, fakkiiwwan amantii fayyadamuun miidhaa fi gidiraa yeroo ammaa Gaza keessatti namoota irra gahaa jiru ifa baasudha.

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts two missiles, two drones in Riyadh
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted two ballistic missiles and two drones aimed at Riyadh by Houthi rebels. This incident follows a period of heightened military conflict across Yemen, particularly in the Marib and al-Jawf regions. Both sides reported significant recent tactical operations and casualties as the regional fighting intensifies.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ አማፂያን ወደ ሪያድ የተተኮሱ ሁለት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን እና ሁለት ድሮኖችን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በየመን በተለይም በማሪብ እና በአል-ጃውፍ አካባቢዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። ሁለቱም ወገኖች በቅርቡ ባደረጓቸው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu, xiyyara maleeyyii fi boombiiwwan mookteetii Huutonni gara Riyaaditti ergaman hunda qilleensa irratti barbadeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Kunis, waraanni Yaman keessatti, keessattuu naannoo Maariibii fi Al-Jaawfitti hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa. Gammachuu waraana kanaatiin walqabatee, giddutti miidhaan namaa fi meeshaalee irra ga’uun isaas gabaasameera.

title: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has fired nine senior security and oil officials following an investigation into massive oil smuggling operations in the Jurf al-Nasr region. The area, controlled by the Iran-backed group Kataib Hezbollah, had been illegally siphoning oil from strategic pipelines through hidden refineries. The government is now taking legal action against those involved and asserting control over areas that previously operated beyond state authority.
amharic: የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛኢዲ በጁርፍ አል-ናስር አካባቢ በተደረገ የነዳጅ ኮንትሮባንድ ምርመራ ዘጠኝ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት እና የነዳጅ ዘርፍ ባለስልጣናትን ከስራ አሰናብተዋል። በኢራን በሚደገፈው ካታኢብ ሄዝቦላህ ቁጥጥር ስር በሚገኘው አካባቢ፣ ህገ-ወጥ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን በመጠቀም ከስትራቴጂካዊ የነዳጅ መስመሮች ነዳጅ ይሰረቅ ነበር። መንግስት በተሳታፊዎች ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እየወሰደ ሲሆን ከዚህ በፊት በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ያልነበሩ አካባቢዎችን ወደ ህግ ለማምጣት እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Iraaq Alii Al-Zaa'idii qorannoo seeraan alaa gurgurtaa boba'aa naannoo Jurf al-Nasr jedhamutti geggeeffame hordofee, hoggantoota nageenyaa fi boba'aa sagal hojiirraa ari'eera. Naannichi garee Iran gargaartu Katayib Hezbullaatiin to'atamu, siirichaa boba'aa biyyattii irraa boba'aa saamuuf rafiinarrii seeraan alaa fayyadamaa ture. Mootummaan namoota yakka kanaan shakkaman seeraatti dhiyeessaa jiraachuu fi naannoo duraan to'annoo mootummaa jala hin turre ammaa booda to'annoo jala oolchuuf murteesseera.

title: Netanyahu sends plea to Eisenkot for unity government
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has publicly asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government with his Likud Party. Eisenkot, who currently faces a December 6 deadline to finalize his own government plans, has rejected the offer. He labeled the Prime Minister's request as a deceptive tactic rather than a genuine political proposal.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ከሊኩድ ፓርቲያቸው ጋር በመቀላቀል አንድነት መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስከ ታህሳስ 6 መንግስት የመመስረት ጊዜ ያላቸው አይዘንኮት ይህንን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። የተቃዋሚው መሪ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን ጥሪ እንደ ማታለያ ስልት በመቁጠር እውነተኛ የመደራደር ፍላጎት የሌለው መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu gaggeessaa mormitootaa Gaadii Ayizankoot waliin mootummaa tokkummaa akka hundeessan gaafataniru. Ayizankoot hanga Muddee 6 tti mootummaa hundeessuuf yeroo qaban keessatti, gaaffii Netaaniyaahuu kana fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Ayizankoot yaada mummichi ministeerichaa dhiyeessan kun kan dhugaa irraa fagaate fi mala xaxaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Thailand’s elderly kept in cages
english: A nursing home in Thailand is facing serious allegations for confining elderly residents inside metal cages. This disturbing situation highlights the growing struggle to provide affordable and humane care for the country's rapidly aging population. As the number of senior citizens continues to rise, the lack of accessible eldercare resources has become a pressing national concern.
amharic: በታይላንድ የሚገኝ አንድ አረጋውያን ማቆያ ጣቢያ፣ አረጋውያንን በብረት ቤት ውስጥ በመቆለፍ እየተከሰሰ ይገኛል። ይህ አስደንጋጭ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የአረጋውያን ቁጥር ተከትሎ ተገቢና ተመጣጣኝ የሆነ የእንክብካቤ አገልግሎት ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ እየሆነ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። አረጋውያን እየበዙ በመምጣታቸው፣ በቂ የመንከባከቢያ አቅርቦት እጥረት አሳሳቢ የሀገር አቀፍ ችግር ሆኗል።
oromo: Buufanni maanguddoota kunuunsu tokko kan Thaayilaand keessatti argamu, maanguddoota keessatti argaman keeyyoo sibiilaa keessatti hidhuun himatameera. Haalli kun akkaataa maanguddoota baay'ataa jiran kanaaf kunuunsa gaarii fi gatii madaala qabu dhiyeessuun itti rakkisaa dhufe agarsiisa. Lakkoofsi maanguddootaa dabalaa waan jiruuf, qabeenya maanguddoota kunuunsuuf gargaaru dhabamuun rakkoo biyyoolessaa cimaa ta'eera.

title: Tsadkan’s “Reforms” Have Fragmented Tigray’s Unity
english: The political campaign led by General Tsadkan Gebretensae and his allies to dismantle the TPLF has caused significant division within Tigray, weakening the region’s unity during a time of recovery. By aligning with federal forces to challenge the TPLF, this faction has alienated parts of the population and deepened historical regional conflicts. Ultimately, these political maneuvers have prioritized internal power struggles over addressing the urgent humanitarian needs and collective trauma of the Tigrayan people.
amharic: ጄኔራል ጻድቃን ገብረትንሳይ እና አጋሮቻቸው ህወሓትን ለማዳከም ያደረጉት የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴ በትግራይ ህዝብ መካከል መከፋፈልን በመፍጠር የክልሉን አንድነት አናግቶታል። ይህ ቡድን ህወሓትን ለመቃወም ከፌዴራል ኃይሎች ጋር በመተባበሩ፣ የክልሉን የውስጥ ሰላም ከመጉዳቱም በላይ የቆዩ የክልል ግጭቶችን ዳግም አቀጣጥሏል። በመጨረሻም፣ እነዚህ የፖለቲካ ሽኩቻዎች የክልሉን ህዝብ አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ችግሮች ከመፍታት ይልቅ ለስልጣን ሽኩቻ ቅድሚያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: General Tsadkan Gebretensae fi degartootni isaa sochiin siyaasaa 'TPLF' diiguuf godhan, tokkummaa Tigraay irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Gareen kun TPLF mormuuf humnoota federaalaa waliin hiriiruun, ummata gidduutti walqoodinsa uumuu fi walitti bu'iinsa kutaalee biyyaa durii deebisee kaaseera. Walumaagalatti, tarkaanfiiwwan siyaasaa kun rakkoowwan namoomaa fi miidhaa garaa garaa ummata Tigraay irra ga'e furuu irra, dhimma aangoof wal dorgomuu irratti xiyyeeffataniiru.

title: Ethiopian Airlines Swaps an Air Force General for a Party Leader
english: Adem Farah, the vice president of the Prosperity Party, has been appointed as the new chairperson of the Ethiopian Airlines Group Board of Directors. He replaces Lieutenant General Yilma Merdassa, the head of the Ethiopian Air Force, who had held the position since June 2023. This leadership change marks a shift back to civilian management for the airline's board after three years of military oversight.
amharic: የብልጽግና ፓርቲ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት አደም ፋራህ የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ግሩፕ ቦርድ ሊቀመንበር ሆነው ተሾመዋል። እርሳቸው የተተኩት ከሰኔ 2015 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በቦርዱ ሊቀመንበርነት ሲያገለግሉ የቆዩትን የአየር ኃይል አዛዥ ሌተና ጀነራል ይልማ መርዳሳን ነው። ይህ የቦርድ አመራር ለውጥ የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ከሶስት ዓመት የጦር መኮንን አመራር በኋላ ወደ ሲቪል አመራር መመለሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Itti aantuun paartii badhaadhinaa Adem Farah itti gaafatamaa boordii dhaabbata geejjiba qilleensaa Itoophiyaa ta'uun muudamaniiru. Isaanis qondaala olaanaa raayyaa ittisaa irraa gara aangoo kanaa kan dhufan Leetenant Jeneraal Yilma Merdassa bakka bu'aniiru. Jijjiiramni kun boordiin dhaabbatichaa waggoota sadii booda qondaala waraanaa irraa gara hogganaa siviiliitti akka deebi'u taasiseera.

title: The Numbers on Inflation Ease, Households Still Pay More
english: Although official government data suggests the economy is growing, ordinary households continue to struggle with the rising cost of living. Many individuals and families report that their income is failing to keep up with the steep increase in rent and basic daily expenses. Despite official reports of easing inflation, the reality for most citizens is a significant financial burden that outweighs the country's paper gains.
amharic: የመንግስት ኦፊሴላዊ መረጃዎች ኢኮኖሚው እያደገ መሆኑን ቢጠቁሙም፣ ተራው ህዝብ ግን በከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እየተፈተነ ይገኛል። ብዙ ግለሰቦችና ቤተሰቦች የገቢ መጠናቸው ከቤት ኪራይና ከዕለት ተዕለት ፍጆታዎች የዋጋ ጭማሪ ጋር እኩል መሄድ እንደተሳነው ይገልጻሉ። የዋጋ ግሽበት መቀነሱን የሚያሳዩ መረጃዎች ቢኖሩም፣ በዕለት ተዕለት ህይወት ውስጥ ያለው የዋጋ ንረት ለብዙዎች ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni mootummaa dinagdeen biyyattii guddachaa jiraachuu ibsus, maatiin hundi garuu gatii jireenyaa olka'aa ta'een rakachaa jiru. Namoonni hedduu fi maatiin mindaan isaanii kiree manaa fi baasii guyyaa guyyaa waliin gahuu dhabuu isaanii dubbatu. Gatiin meeshaalee hir'achaa jiraachuu kan himamu ta'us, dhugaan jiru garuu baasiin jireenyaa miindaa isaanii caalee harka qalleeyyi irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Bank Chiefs to Head to Ideological Classes, Summoned by the Regulator
english: Leaders of commercial banks in Ethiopia have been instructed by the national financial regulator to attend ideological training sessions organized by the ruling Prosperity Party. These sessions are designed to align bank executives with the political vision of the administration. This directive highlights the government's increasing efforts to influence the management of private and state-run financial institutions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንኮች ፕሬዚዳንቶች እና ምክትል ፕሬዚዳንቶች በገዢው ብልጽግና ፓርቲ የተዘጋጀ የስልጠና መርሃ ግብር ላይ እንዲገኙ በቁጥጥር አካል ታዝዘዋል። ይህ ስልጠና የባንክ አመራሮችን ከመንግስት የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ጋር ለማቀናጀት ያለመ ነው። ይህም መንግስት በፋይናንስ ተቋማት ላይ ያለውን ተፅዕኖ ለማጠናከር እየሰራ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni baankiiwwan daldala Itoophiyaa qajeelfama qaama to'ataa mootummaan gara leenjii ideolojii kan paartii badhaadhinaa dhaabbate akka dhaqan ajajamanii jiru. Leenjichi hoggantoota baankiiwwanii yaad-rimee siyaasaa mootummaa wajjin walitti fiduuf kan qophaaye dha. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan dhaabbilee faayinaansii irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalii gochaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Climate Conference Brings a State Rival to Premium Car Hire Market
english: Ethiopian Investment Holdings has launched Shabeel Fleets Enterprise to provide high-end transportation and logistics services for summit delegations. The company will focus on offering professional chauffeur services and coordinating event logistics. While the state-run sovereign fund started this initiative, specific details regarding the fleet size, total investment, and potential contracts remain undisclosed.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ኢንቨስትመንት ሆልዲንግስ ለስብሰባ ልዑካን የላቀ የትራንስፖርት እና የሎጂስቲክስ አገልግሎት ለመስጠት 'ሻቤል ፍሊትስ ኢንተርፕራይዝ' የተሰኘ ኩባንያ አቋቁሟል። ድርጅቱ በዋናነት ለከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት የማመላለሻ እና የዝግጅት አስተባባሪ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት ታቅዶ የተቋቋመ ነው። የመንግስት የልማት ድርጅት ይህንን ቢጀምርም፣ ስለ ተሽከርካሪዎቹ ብዛት፣ ስለ ኢንቨስትመንቱ መጠን እና ስለ ኮንትራት ዝርዝሮች እስካሁን ይፋ የተደረገ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Qabeenya Investimantii Itoophiyaa ergamoota walga'iiwwaniif tajaajila geejjibaa fi loojistikii ammayyaa ta'e dhiyeessuuf dhaabbata 'Shabeel Fleets Enterprise' jedhamu hundeesseera. Dhaabbatichi tajaajila konkolaachisaa ogeessotaa fi qindeessuu qophiiwwan adda addaa irratti xiyyeeffata. Mootummaan dhaabbata kana kan hundeesse ta'us, baay'ina konkolaattotaa, baajata ramadame fi waliigaltee dhimma kanaa irratti odeeffannoon bal'aan ammaaf hin kennamne.

title: New Amhara Bank Case Alleges 200m Br Loan on Phantom Trucks
english: Federal prosecutors have charged a former Amhara Bank manager, Mesfin Getachew, and a client, Chalachew Taye, with corruption and fraud. The case involves an alleged 200 million Birr loan secured by non-existent trucks. Both suspects have been detained since October following an investigation by the Addis Abeba Police Commission.
amharic: የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞ የአማራ ባንክ ስራ አስኪያጅ መስፍን ጌታቸው እና ደንበኛቸው ቻላቸው ታዬ ላይ በሙስና እና በማጭበርበር ወንጀል ክስ መስርቷል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ባልነበሩ የጭነት መኪናዎች ስም 200 ሚሊዮን ብር ብድር ወስደዋል ተብለው ተከሰውል። በአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ ኮሚሽን በተደረገ ምርመራ ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ከጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa federalaa, maanejarri duraanii Baanki Amharaa Mesfin Geetachoo fi maamiltoon isaa Chalachoo Taayee irratti himata malaammaltummaa fi gowwoomsuu dhiyeesseera. Himannaan kun liqii qarshii miiliyoona 200 kan ta'u, konkolaattota hin jirre fayyadamuun fudhatamee ture kan jedhu dha. Shakkamtoonni kunniin qorannoo Komishinii Poolisii Finfinneetiin booda ji'a Sadaasaa irraa eegalee hidhaa keessa jiru.

title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
english: A nationwide flight suspension across the US was triggered by technical errors during a project to replace outdated copper wiring with fiber optics. Transport Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the incident was not a cyber-attack, though officials are investigating whether the disruption was caused by equipment failure or contractor error. This event led to thousands of cancellations and delays, marking the most significant disruption to American air travel since the September 11 attacks.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የተከሰተው የሀገር አቀፍ የበረራ መስተጓጎል የድሮውን የመዳብ ገመድ በፋይበር ኦፕቲክስ ለመቀየር በተደረገ የቴክኖሎጂ ማሻሻያ ወቅት በተፈጠረ ስህተት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ሾን ዳፊ ጉዳዩ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ችግሩ በመሳሪያዎች ብልሽት ወይስ በኮንትራክተሩ ስህተት እንደተፈጠረ ምርመራ እየተደረገ ነው። ይህ ክስተት ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት በኋላ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎችን በመሰረዝ እና በማዘግየት በሀገሪቱ የአየር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hojiin bu'uraalee gamtoominaa fi quunnamtii ammayyeessuuf jecha ergoo sibiilaa (copper wire) gara fayibar optiksitti jijjiiruuf godhame, guutummaa Ameerikaa keessatti balallii xiyyaaraa akka dhaabatu godheera. Ministirri Dhimma Geejjibaa, Sean Duffy akka ibsanitti, rakkoon kun hojii sana irratti uumame malee miidhaa haxxee (cyber-attack) miti; ta'us, rakkoon kun meeshaalee fiixuu dhabuu moo dogoggora dhaabbata hojicha geggeessaa ture irraa akka dhufe qorannoon irratti godhamaa jira. Mudannoon kun erga weerara garaa garaa bara 2001 booda kanneen biroo caalaa balallii xiyyaaraa miidhuun, kumaan lakkaawwaman akka haaqaman fi turan godheera.

title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
english: Italian regulators have penalized Meta with an 805 million euro fine for accessing Android users' photos without clear permission. The authority found that Meta failed to properly inform nearly 20 million users that a Facebook feature was scanning their personal image galleries to suggest social media posts. The company has been ordered to disable this feature by default within two months and must obtain explicit consent from users, though Meta intends to challenge the ruling.
amharic: የጣሊያን ተቆጣጣሪ አካላት ሜታ የተባለውን ኩባንያ የአንድሮይድ ተጠቃሚዎችን ፎቶዎች ያለ በቂ ፈቃድ በመጠቀሙ 805 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ ቀጥተዋል። ኩባንያው ወደ 20 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ተጠቃሚዎች የፌስቡክ አፕሊኬሽን የግል ፎቶዎቻቸውን ለፖስት ሃሳብነት እንደሚጠቀም በግልፅ አለማሳወቁ ተረጋግጧል። በሁለት ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ ይህን ባህሪ በነባሪነት እንዲያቆም እና ከተጠቃሚዎች ግልጽ ፈቃድ እንዲያገኝ የታዘዘ ሲሆን፣ ሜታ ግን ውሳኔውን እንደሚቃወም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii dhaabbata Meetaa fayyadamtoota Android fedhii isaanii malee suuraa isaanii waan qorateef yeroo 805 miiliyoona Yuuroo akka kaffalu dirqisiiseera. Dhaabbatichi fayyadamtoota miiliyoona 20 ta'anitti appilikeeshiniin Facebook suuraa isaanii gorsa postii godhachuuf akka fayyadamu ifatti hin himne. Meetaan suuraa kana gosa 'default' ta'een kutaachuu fi fayyadamtoota irraa hayyama sirrii ta'e argachuu akka qabu ajajameera, ta'us dhaabbatichi murtii kana irratti ol-iyyannoo galfachuu akka qabu ibseera.

title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
english: Nineteen-year-old singer Carmelle from the Philippines has won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok. She secured the victory with her empowering track 'Sobra-Sobra,' earning top marks from both the professional jury and the public audience. The competition featured eleven different countries and concluded with Thailand taking second place and Vietnam placing third.
amharic: ከፊሊፒንስ የተወጣችው የ19 ዓመቷ ድምጻዊት ካርሜል ባንኮክ በተካሄደው የመጀመሪያው የእስያ የዩሮቪዥን ዘፈን ውድድር አሸናፊ ሆናለች። ካርሜል ድሉን ያገኘችው 'ሶብራ-ሶብራ' በተሰኘው የሴቶች አቅምን የሚያጎለብት ዘፈኗ ሲሆን ከዳኞችም ሆነ ከህዝብ ከፍተኛ ድምጽ አግኝታለች። በውድድሩ 11 ሀገራት የተሳተፉ ሲሆን ታይላንድ በሁለተኛነት፣ ቬትናም ደግሞ በሶስተኛነት ተቀምጠዋል።
oromo: Weellistuun umurii waggaa 19 kan taate Carmelle jedhamtu biyya Filippiinsii irraa dhuftu, dorgommii muuziqaa Euroovizhen Eeshiyaa kan jalqabaa Baangkookitti gaggeeffame injifatteetti. Carmelle injifannoo kana kan gonfatte sirba 'Sobra-Sobra' jedhamu kan dubartoota jajjabeessuun yoo ta'u, abbootii murtii fi ummata biraa sagalee olaanaa argatteetti. Dorgommichi biyyoota 11 kan hirmaachise yoo ta'u, Taayilaandi lammaffaa, Veetinaamis sadaffaa ta'uun xumurameera.

title: Can being ‘non-Western’ cost you your home in Denmark?
english: Denmark's Supreme Court is currently reviewing a controversial policy that classifies residents as either 'Western' or 'non-Western.' This legal debate focuses on whether the government has the right to force families out of their homes based on these demographic labels. Affected residents are now challenging these evictions in court, arguing against the fairness of the housing legislation.
amharic: የዴንማርክ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ነዋሪዎችን እንደ 'ምዕራባዊ' እና 'ምዕራባዊ ያልሆነ' በሚል የሚከፋፍለውን አወዛጋቢ ህግ እየመረመረ ይገኛል። ክርክሩ በዋነኝነት የሚያተኩረው መንግስት በእነዚህ መለያዎች ላይ ተመስርቶ ቤተሰቦችን ከቤታቸው የማፈናቀል መብት አለው ወይ የሚለው ላይ ነው። የተጎዱ ነዋሪዎችም ይህ የቤቶች ህግ ፍትሃዊ አይደለም በማለት በህግ እየተከራከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa kan Deenmaarkitti, namoota akka 'Lixaa' fi 'Lixaa hin taane'tti gargar qoqqooduun seerota murteessaa jiru irratti mari'achaa jira. Falmiin kun mootummaan gargar baasuun kana irratti hundaa'ee maatiiwwan mana isaanii irraa buqqisuu mirga qabaa jedhu irratti xiyyeeffata. Jiraattonni miidhaan irra ga'e, seeronni manaa kun walqixxummaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun mana murtiitti falmachaa jiru.

title: Deadly car bomb blast kills two near Syria’s capital
english: A car bomb explosion in the town of Jaramana, located near the Syrian capital of Damascus, has resulted in the deaths of two people, including a man and a young girl. Following the attack, local security forces quickly secured the site to prevent further harm. Authorities have initiated a formal investigation to determine the circumstances behind the blast.
amharic: ሶሪያ ዋና ከተማ ደማስቆ አቅራቢያ በምትገኝ ጃራማና በተባለች ከተማ በደረሰ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት አንድ ወንድ እና አንዲት ህጻን ልጅ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ የጸጥታ ሃይሎች አካባቢውን በመቆጣጠር ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ በቦምብ ፍንዳታው ዙሪያ ሰፊ ማጣራት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Siiriyaa Daamaasqoos biratti argamtu, Jaaramanaa jedhamtutti konkolaataa keessa fashaleen boombii lammiilee lama, dhiira tokko fi intala xiqqoo tokko ajjeeseera. Erga miidhaan kun qaqqabee booda, humnoonni nageenyaa naannichatti argamuun qorannoo eegaleera. Mootummaan sababa fi namoota yakka kana raawwatan adda baasuuf qorannoo bal’aa geggeessaa jira.

title: More than 100,000 rally across France in new Yellow Vest protests
english: Over 100,000 demonstrators marched across France to protest rising living costs, low wages, and government policies. While the nationwide turnout was lower than in previous weeks, clashes involving tear gas occurred in several major cities. Protesters also expressed strong dissatisfaction with President Macron and announced plans for further strikes following the rejection of a proposed wage increase.
amharic: ከ100,000 በላይ ሰልፈኞች በፈረንሳይ የኑሮ ውድነትን፣ ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝን እና የመንግስትን ፖሊሲዎች በመቃወም ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። በአገሪቱ አቀፍ ደረጃ የተሳታፊዎች ቁጥር ከቀደምት ሳምንታት አንጻር ቀንሶ ቢታይም፣ በተለያዩ ዋና ዋና ከተሞች የፖሊስ አስለቃሽ ጭስ መጠቀሙን ተከትሎ ግጭቶች ተከስተዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ በፕሬዚዳንት ማክሮን ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት ያቀረበውን አነስተኛ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ በመቃወም በቀጣይ አድማ እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Namoonni 100,000 ol ta'an Faransaay keessatti gatii jireenyaa olka'e, mindaa xiqqaa fi imaammata mootummaa mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen haala guyyoota darban irra xiqqataa dhufeen illee, magaalonni gurguddoon tokko tokko walitti bu'insaafi fayyadama gaazii imimmaansuu agartaniiru. Hiriirtonni prezidaant Maakroon irratti mormii cimaa kan agarsiisan yoo ta'u, mootummaan mindaa dabaluuf waadaa gale fudhatama dhabeera jedhanii, gara fuulduraatti deemsa sochii fi kottoonfannaa (strike) itti fufuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Tens of thousands march in latest Portugal housing protests
english: Tens of thousands of people across Portugal recently marched in over 30 cities to demand government action against the country's severe housing crisis. Protesters are calling for rent caps, better tenant protections, and stricter regulations on short-term rentals, citing that housing costs have drastically outpaced local wages. This movement, the largest of its kind, opposes recent legislative changes that they fear will make it easier for landlords to evict tenants and increase costs.
amharic: በፖርቱጋል በሚገኙ ከ30 በላይ ከተሞች በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች በሀገሪቱ የከፋ የመኖሪያ ቤት ችግር ላይ የመንግስትን እርምጃ በመጠየቅ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋ እንዲወሰን፣ የተከራዮች መብት እንዲጠበቅ እና ለአጭር ጊዜ ኪራዮች ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። የኑሮ ውድነቱ ከደመወዝ ጭማሪ ጋር ያልተመጣጠነ መሆኑን የገለጹት ሰልፈኞቹ፣ በቅርቡ በፓርላማ የጸደቁት አዳዲስ ህጎች ተከራዮችን ለችግር እንደሚዳርጉ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Purtugaal keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman magaaloolee 30 ol keessatti hiriira guddaa ba’uun rakkoo mana jireenyaa biyyattii keessatti mul’atuuf furmaata akka kennamu mootummaa gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni kun gatii kiree mana jireenyaa irratti daangaan akka kaa’amu, mirgi kireeffattootaa akka kabajamuufi qajeelfamoonni kiree manaa jabaachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Gatiin mana jireenyaa mindaa hojjettootaa caalaa dabaluu isaa kan morman hiriirtonni kun, seeronni haaraa mana kiree ilaalchisee ba’an kireeffattoota miidhuu akka danda’an ibsaniiru.

title: Pope Leo urges end to violence in Peru during visit to remote Andes town
english: Pope Leo XIV recently visited Peru, where he called for an end to the rising violence and criminality affecting the nation. During his visit to an Andean town, he encouraged citizens to combat injustice through patience, prayer, and persistent action rather than brutality. He also highlighted the hardships faced by rural communities, noting that many people are leaving their homes due to economic instability and social challenges.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፔሩ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኃይል ጥቃት እና ወንጀል እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በአንዲት የአንዲስ ከተማ ባደረጉት ጉብኝት፣ ህዝቡ ኢፍትሐዊነትን በኃይል ከመመከት ይልቅ በትዕግስት እና በጸሎት እንዲወጡ መክረዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በገጠር አካባቢዎች የሚገኙ ማህበረሰቦች በኢኮኖሚ ችግር እና በማህበራዊ ጫና ምክንያት መንደሮቻቸውን ለቀው ለመሰደድ መገደዳቸውን አንስተዋል።
oromo: Papaa Leewoo 14ffaan biyya Peeruu keessatti gochaa jeequmsaafi yakka biyyattii mudate dhaabsisuuf waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Magaalaa naannoo Andesitti yeroo dubbatan, lammiileen immoo haqaa dhabuu irratti humnaan deebii kennuu mannaa, obsaafi kadhannaan jijjiirama fiduu akka qaban gorfaniiru. Kana malees, ummanni baadiyyaa hiyyummaafi rakkoo jiru irraa kan ka'e, mana isaanii dhiisanii gara magaalotaatti godaanuun isaanii akka isaan yaaddessu ibsaniiru.

title: John Fetterman threatens to quit Democratic Party if next Senate leader is critical of Israel
english: Senator John Fetterman has warned that he might leave the Democratic Party if his colleagues elect a Senate leader who is critical of Israel. Fetterman specifically expressed opposition to Senator Chris Van Hollen, who is seeking the leadership role and has been vocal about the humanitarian crisis in Gaza. This stance highlights the deep divisions within the party regarding their approach to Israel and its policies.
amharic: ሴናተር ጆን ፌተርማን የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲ የሚቃወም ሰው የሴኔት መሪ ሆኖ ከተመረጠ ከዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ሊለቁ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ፌተርማን በተለይም ለሴኔት መሪነት እየተወዳደሩ ያሉትን እና በጋዛ ስላለው የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ ተቃውሞ ሲያሰሙ የቆዩትን ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለንን እንደሚቃወሙ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በእስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Senator John Fetterman qaama hogganaa seeneetii kan ta'e yoo Israa'elitti qeeqa dhiyeesse paartii Dimookraatikii keessaa ba'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Fetterman keessattuu Senator Chris Van Hollen kan hogganummaa barbaadan fi haala namoomaa Gaaza irratti qeeqa qaban mormuusaanii ibseera. Ta'uun kun dhimma Israa'el irratti paarticha keessatti yaada wal-dhabdee jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems
english: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya is demanding immediate repairs to Gaza's sanitation and drainage infrastructure following severe flooding that destroyed numerous tents used by displaced people. He criticized Israel's ongoing restrictions on fuel and essential supplies, which are preventing necessary reconstruction efforts. Al-Hayya described the situation as a deliberate policy of starvation and destruction, calling for unrestricted access for humanitarian aid organizations.
amharic: የሃማስ የፖለቲካ ቢሮ ኃላፊ ካሊል አል-ሃያ በጋዛ የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ የሆኑትን ድንኳኖች ካወደመ በኋላ፣ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃዎችን በአስቸኳይ እንዲጠግኑ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ የጣለችው የነዳጅ እና የምግብ እገዳ መሰረተ ልማቶችን ለመጠገን እንቅፋት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። አል-ሃያ አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ የጦርነት ውጤት ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጠረ የረሃብ እና የውድመት ፖሊሲ በመሆኑ፣ የሰብአዊ ድርጅቶች ያለ ገደብ እርዳታ እንዲያቀርቡ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Hamaas Khalil al-Hayya, rooba cimaa magaalaa Gaazaatti roobeen dunkaanonni baqattootaa miidhamuu hordofee, sirni dhangala'aa bishaanii fi dhangala'aan magaalaa sun saffisaan akka suphamu gaafataniiru. Innis Israa'el gargaarsa namoomaa fi boba'aa irratti uggura kaa'uun ishee, hojii haaromsaa gufachiisuu ishee balaaleffateera. Al-Hayya haalli amma jiru kun balaa tasaa osoo hin taane, tarsiimoo beelaa fi badiisaa qormaata ta'e waan ta'eef, dhaabbileen gargaarsaa ittigaafatamummaa guutuun akka galan gaafataniiru.

title: Houthis report 72 Saudi-led coalition air strikes across Yemen
english: A Houthi spokesperson announced that the Saudi-led coalition conducted 72 aerial attacks across four Yemeni provinces within a single day. These strikes are part of a broader military campaign that has seen over 5,000 combined air and missile attacks since the summer. The announcement highlights a significant intensification in the ongoing conflict in the region.
amharic: የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንዳስታወቁት፣ በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ በአራት የየመን ግዛቶች ላይ 72 የአየር ጥቃቶችን አድርሷል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በበጋው ወቅት ግጭቶች እንደገና ከተቀሰቀሱ ወዲህ ከተፈጸሙ ከ5,000 በላይ የአየር እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች አካል ናቸው። ይህ መግለጫ በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Huutii akka ibsetti, gamtaan Sa'udii durfamu guyyaa tokko keessatti naannolee Yaman afur keessatti 72 irra deddeebi'anii haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun gannaa darbe erga waraanni deebi'ee jalqabee as, haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa waraana gurguddaa walitti qabamee 5,000 ol ta'u keessaa tokko dha. Ibsi kun naannichatti waraanni amma jiru sadarkaa olaanaatti cehuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Saudi Arabia executes former child protester Jawad Qureiris
english: Saudi Arabia has executed Jawad Qureiris, a man who was arrested for his participation in protests when he was a child. Alongside another individual, he was convicted of various terrorism-related charges, though his family and human rights groups maintain he was tortured into giving false confessions. These executions mark the fifth case since 2025 involving individuals put to death for actions taken during their youth.

oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan Jawad Qureiris nama yeroo ijoollummaa isaa hiriira irratti hirmaateef hidhamee ture ajjeesteetti. title: ‘Loss of confidence’: US Navy fires commanders of warships deployed against Iran
english: The US Navy has removed several high-ranking officers from their posts, including leaders of the USS South Dakota submarine and the USS Michael Murphy destroyer, due to issues like performance concerns and accidents. This move has sparked controversy because the Navy did not officially announce the removals or notify Congress in a timely manner. Lawmakers are now questioning the military's transparency, particularly regarding how information about regional tensions and potential damage from conflicts with Iran is being managed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል የዩኤስኤስ ሳውዝ ዳኮታ ሰርጓጅ መርከብን እና የዩኤስኤስ ማይክል መርፊ አጥፊ መርከብን ጨምሮ በርካታ ከፍተኛ መኮንኖችን ከኃላፊነታቸው አንስቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ይፋዊ መግለጫ ሳይሰጥ እና ለኮንግረስ ሳይገለጽ መደረጉ የህግ አውጪዎችን ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። በዚህም ሳቢያ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ግልጽነት እና ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ውጥረት ዙሪያ መረጃን ስለማስተዳደር ያላቸው አሰራር ከፍተኛ ጥያቄ ውስጥ ወድቋል።
oromo: Humni galaana Amerikaa (US Navy) ajajoota olaanoo muraasa, kanneen akka hogganoota markaba lolaa 'USS South Dakota' fi 'USS Michael Murphy' hojii irraa ari'eera. Murteen kun ibsa ifaa malee fi mana maree biyyattii (Congress) osoo hin beeksisin fudhatamuu isaatiin mormii cimaa uumeera. Kana irraa kan ka'e, mootummaan Amerikaa ibsa kennuu irratti qabanuufi dhimmoota nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa Iraan wajjin jiru irratti odeeffannoo haguuguu isaaniitiin qeeqa gurguddaa mudachaa jiru.

title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that US negotiators have proposed a potential deal where Ukraine would give up control of the Donbas region in exchange for joining NATO. While Kyiv has historically refused to cede sovereign territory, Zelensky indicated he would consider putting a comprehensive peace plan to a public vote if it included strong security guarantees. Despite these discussions, Russia's demands for neutrality and territorial control remain largely unchanged, leaving the path to a resolution uncertain.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ እንደገለጹት የአሜሪካ የድርድር ቡድን ዩክሬን የዶንባስ ክልልን በመልቀቅ በምትኩ የኔቶ አባል እንድትሆን ሀሳብ አቅርበዋል። ዩክሬን ግዛቷን አሳልፎ ለመስጠት ፈቃደኛ ባትሆንም፣ ዘለንስኪ አስተማማኝ የደህንነት ዋስትናዎችን የያዘ አጠቃላይ የሰላም ስምምነት ቢቀርብላቸው ለህዝብ ውሳኔ ሊያቀርቡት እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል። ምንም እንኳን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም፣ የሩሲያ የግዛት እና የገለልተኝነት ፍላጎቶች ሳይቀየሩ በመቆየታቸው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት መፍትሄ አሁንም አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski akka jedhanitti, bakka bu’oonni Ameerikaa Yukreen naannoo Donbaas gadi lhiistee miseensa NATO ta’uu akka dandeessu yaada dhiyeessaniiru. Yukreen guutummaatti biyyee ishee gadi lhiisuu kan hin barbaanne ta’us, Zeelenski waadaa nageenyaa cimaa qabu yoo ta’e, yaada kana irratti uummanni akka murteessu gochuu akka danda’u ibsaniiru. Haa ta’u malee, Rashiyaan naannoo fi dirqama loogummaa malee jiraachuu (neutrality) ilaalchisee fedhii qabdu jijjiiramuu dhabuun ishee, xumura waraana kanaa kan shakkisiisu ta’eera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces occupy Palestinian-American’s home
english: Israeli military forces seized control of a home belonging to a Palestinian-American in the occupied West Bank for over two weeks. During the same period, soldiers interrupted a Palestinian wedding ceremony to take the groom into custody. These incidents occurred alongside ongoing and lethal Israeli military operations throughout the Gaza Strip.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኝ የአንድ ፍልስጤማዊ-አሜሪካዊ መኖሪያ ቤትን ለ17 ቀናት ተቆጣጥረውት ነበር። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ወታደሮቹ በፈጸሙት ወረራ አንድ የፍልስጤም ሰርግ ላይ በመግባት ሙሽራውን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በተከታታይ ገዳይ ጥቃቶች እየተፈጸሙበት ካለው የጋዛ ሰርጥ ሁኔታ ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Israa'el mana lammii Palestiinii kan ta'e kan Ameerikaa jiru tokko naannoo Waan Baankitti guyyoota 17f qabatanii turan. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, waraanni kun cidha tokko gidduutti seenuun misirrichicha hidhaniiru. Gochi kunis haleellaa waraana Israa'el kan gaazaatti guyyaa guyyaan gaggeeffamaa jiru waliin kan wal qabatu dha.

title: NASA’s Voyager 1 to hit new space distance record of one light-day
english: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is set to become the first human-made object to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth. Launched in 1977, the spacecraft continues to provide valuable scientific data while traveling through interstellar space. Although mission engineers are managing communication challenges, the probe remains a historic achievement in space exploration.
amharic: የናሳው የቮዬጀር 1 የጠፈር መርማሪ ከምድር አንድ የብርሃን ቀን ርቀት ላይ የሚደርስ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሰራሽ ዕቃ ሊሆን ነው። በ1977 የተጀመረው ይህ መርማሪ በከዋክብት መካከል ባለው ክፍተት ውስጥ እየተጓዘ ጠቃሚ ሳይንሳዊ መረጃዎችን መላኩን ቀጥሏል። የናሳ መሐንዲሶች የመገናኛ ችግሮችን እየፈቱ ቢሆንም፣ የጠፈር መርማሪው በጠፈር ምርምር ታሪክ ውስጥ ትልቅ ስኬት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Iskiriinjiin NASA Voyager 1 jedhamu meeshaa namaan hojjetamee lafarraa fagaatee guyyaa ifaa tokko (one light-day) gahuun jalqabaa ta'uuf jira. bara 1977 kan ergame kun, iddoo urjiilee gidduu jiru keessa socho'aa odeeffannoo saayinsii barbaachisaa ta'e gara lafaatti ergaa jira. Injineeronnii NASA rakkoolee qunnamtii mudatan furuuf tattaaffii godhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, ergaa ergame kun seenaa qorannoo hawaa keessatti galmee guddaa qaba.

title: Canada’s Stelco to recall 175 workers after government pressure
english: The Canadian steelmaker Stelco has agreed to rehire 175 employees and provide them with back pay after the government threatened legal action against its US owner, Cleveland-Cliffs. The company had originally laid off the workers due to market challenges and trade tariffs, but officials argued this move broke previous employment commitments. This decision follows significant pressure from labor unions and the Canadian government, which insisted that the company must honor its promises to maintain local jobs.
amharic: የካናዳው ብረት አምራች ኩባንያ ስቴልኮ (Stelco)፣ የካናዳ መንግስት በባለቤቱ በአሜሪካው ክሊቭላንድ-ክሊፍስ ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ካስጠነቀቀ በኋላ፣ 175 ሰራተኞችን መልሶ ለመቅጠር እና የደመወዝ ክፍያቸውን ለማካካስ ተስማምቷል። ኩባንያው ሰራተኞቹን ያሰናበተው በገበያ ችግሮች እና በታሪፍ ምክንያት ቢሆንም፣ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን የቅጥር ቃል የጣሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሰራተኛ ማህበራት እና የካናዳ መንግስት በኩባንያው ላይ ባደረጉት ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Warshaan sibiilaa kan Kaanaadaa Stelco jedhamu, mootummaan kan isaa kan ta'e Cleveland-Cliffs irratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachuuf erga doorsisee booda, hojjattoota 175 gara hojii deebisuufi kaffaltii kaffalamuu qabuufiif waliigaleera. Dhaabbatichi hojjattoota kana kan geggeesse rakkoo gabaafi gibira irratti hundaa'ee ta'us, mootummaan immoo tarkaanfiin kun waadaa kanaan dura seename kan cabse ta'uu ibse. Murteen kun dhiibbaa cimaa gamtaa hojjattootaafi mootummaa Kaanaadaa irraa isaaniif godhameen booda kan fudhatameedha.

title: Empower conference: officials and youth discuss peace and security
english: The Empower Conference in Doha recently brought together government officials and young people to explore strategies for promoting international peace and security. A primary focus of the event was identifying ways to protect and improve educational opportunities for vulnerable and marginalized populations. Participants engaged in collaborative discussions aimed at fostering long-term stability through youth involvement and better policy frameworks.
amharic: በዶሃ በተካሄደው የኢምፓወር ኮንፈረንስ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እና ወጣቶች ለአለም አቀፍ ሰላም እና ደህንነት መፍትሄዎችን ለመወያየት ተሰብስበው ነበር። የዝግጅቱ ዋና ትኩረት ችግር ውስጥ ላሉ እና ተهمለው ለሚታዩ ማህበረሰቦች የትምህርት እድሎችን እንዴት መጠበቅ እንደሚቻል ላይ ነበር። ተሳታፊዎቹ በወጣቶች ተሳትፎ እና በተሻለ የፖሊሲ ማዕቀፎች አማካኝነት ዘላቂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት የጋራ ውይይት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Konfaransii 'Empower' Dohaatti geggeeffame irratti, qaamoleen mootummaa fi dargaggoonni nageenyaa fi tasgabbii addunyaa irratti mari'ataniiru. Qophii kana irratti xiyyeeffannoon guddaan kennameef hawaasa miidhamtootaa fi harka qalleeyyii ta'aniif carraa barnootaa eeguu fi fooyyessuu irratti dha. Hirmaattoonni kun hirmaannaa dargaggootaa fi imaammata gaarii diriirsuun nageenya buusuu irratti walii galtee irra ga'aniiru.

title: Three Israelis emerge as possible successors to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, local media says
english: Jensen Huang has stepped down as the CEO of Nvidia, leading the company to appoint Colette Kress as the interim leader. Media reports suggest that three Israeli tech executives—Michael Kagan, Eyal Waldman, and Johny Srouji—are being considered as potential permanent replacements. This leadership change follows Huang's sudden resignation amid internal and external investigations regarding his personal conduct and potential security implications.
amharic: ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከኤንቪዲያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚነት በድንገት መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ኩባንያው ኮሌት ክሬስን ጊዜያዊ መሪ አድርጎ ሾሟል። እንደ ሚዲያ ዘገባዎች ከሆነ ሶስት እስራኤላውያን የቴክኖሎጂ ባለሙያዎች—ማይክል ካጋን፣ ኢያል ዋልድማን እና ጆኒ ስሩጂ—ለቋሚነት ቦታው እንደ እጩዎች እየተነሱ ነው። የዚህ የአመራር ለውጥ የተፈጠረው የኩባንያው ቦርድ ከሁአንግ የግል ግንኙነቶች እና የደህንነት ስጋቶች ጋር በተያያዘ ምርመራ እያካሄደ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Jensen Huang hoji geggeessituu Nvidia irraa gadhiisuu isaanii hordofee, kampaaniin Colette Kress bakka bu'aa yeroo gochuun muudeera. Gabaasni miidiyaalee akka agarsiisutti, ogeeyyonni teknoloojii Israa'el sadii—Michael Kagan, Eyal Waldman fi Johny Srouji—bakka bu'oota dhaabbataa ta'uu danda'u jedhamee yaadamaa jiru. Jijjiirraan hogganummaa kun kan dhufe, booda yeroo boordiin kampaanii fi qorannoon alaa waa'ee jireenya dhuunfaa fi nageenyaa hogganaa duraanii kanaa irratti gaggeeffamaa ture.

title: Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries condemn Israeli strike on Nasser hospital
english: Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority nations have jointly denounced an Israeli military strike on the Nasser Medical Complex that resulted in multiple deaths. The coalition accused Israel of violating international law and impeding the delivery of vital aid and medical supplies to Gaza. They are urging an immediate end to these hostilities to protect civilians and preserve the existing ceasefire agreement.
amharic: አስራ ስምንት የእስልምና እምነት ተከታይ አገራት ዲፕሎማቶች በናሰር ሆስፒታል ላይ የተፈጸመውን የእስራኤል ጥቃት በአስቸኳይ አውግዘዋል። አገራቱ እስራኤል ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን እንደጣሰች እና ለጋዛ ህዝብ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች እንዳይደርሱ እያገደች እንደሆነ ከሰዋል። ግጭቱ እንዲቆም እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታዎች ያለምንም እንቅፋት እንዲገቡም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Muslimoota hedduu ta'an 18 ta'an, haleellaa Israa'el hospitaala Naasir irratti raawwatte cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Biyyoonni kunneen Israa'el seera idil-addunyaa cabsitee gargaarsa fayyaa fi namoomaa daangaa Gaazaa akka hin geenye dhorkaa jirti jedhaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun akka dhaabatuu fi gargaarsi namoomaa daangaa malee akka seenuuf mootummoonni kunneen yaamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Iran says it intercepted US MQ-1 Predator drone over Qeshm Island
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claims to have successfully shot down a United States MQ-1 Predator drone near Qeshm Island. According to state media, the military used a sophisticated air defense system to stop the aircraft during an alleged spying operation. Iranian officials have characterized the drone's presence as an act of aggression by the American military.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ሰራዊት በቅርቡ በቁሽም ደሴት አቅራቢያ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስን MQ-1 ፕሬዳተር ድሮን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደዘገቡት፣ ኢራን አዲሱን የራሷን የፀረ-አየር መከላከያ መሳሪያ በመጠቀም የስለላ ተልዕኮ ላይ የነበረውን አሜሪካዊ አውሮፕላን ማውደም ችላለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች የፈጸሙት የጥቃት ሙከራ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Furee Irraan (IRGC) xiyyaraan malee kan Ameerikaa (MQ-1 Predator) ganda Qeshm jedhamu irraa akka gadi buufatan beeksisaniiru. Miidiyaaleen mootummaa akka gabaasanitti, Irraan meeshaa itti-dhukaasa xiyyaaraa haaraa fi ammayyaa fayyadamuun, xiyyaaricha kanneen ilaalcha basaasummaa qaban of duuba deebisaniiru. Bulchiinsi Irraan tarkaanfii kana gocha diinummaa kan loltoota Ameerikaati jechuun himateera.

title: Oil tanker on fire in Strait of Hormuz: Iran's navy
english: A series of explosions and fires have hit multiple oil tankers traveling through the Strait of Hormuz within the last day. The Iranian navy claims these vessels were targeted due to unauthorized activity and the disabling of their tracking devices. While the exact identities of the ships remain undisclosed, reports suggest they were damaged by naval mines or direct strikes.
amharic: ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚያልፉ በርካታ የነዳጅ መርከቦች በእሳትና በፍንዳታ ተጎድተዋል። የኢራን የባህር ኃይል መርከቦቹ የክትትል ስርዓታቸውን በማጥፋት እና በተከለከሉ ቦታዎች ላይ ህገ-ወጥ እንቅስቃሴ በማድረጋቸው እንደተጠቁ ገልጿል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው መርከቦች በማዕድን ወይም በኃይል ጥቃት እንደተመቱ ቢነገርም፣ የትኞቹ መርከቦች እንደሆኑ ግን እስካሁን አልተገለጸም።
oromo: Sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti markaleen boba'aa hedduun daandii bishaan Hormuz keessa utuu deemanii ibiddaa fi dhoohaan mudateera. Humnoonni waraana bishaan keessa Irran akka jedhanitti, markaleen kun kan miidhaman sirna hordoffii isaanii cufuudhaan bakka dhoorkaa ta'etti gocha seeraan alaa waan raawwataniifidha. Markaleen miidhaan irra ga'e kun maayinii bishaan keessaatiin ykn haleellaa kallattiin kan rukutaman ta'us, eenyummaan isaanii hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane.

title: Amnesty urges Pakistan-administered Kashmir to free activists and end crackdown
english: Amnesty International has called on the government of Pakistan-administered Kashmir to release activists detained under anti-terrorism laws for protesting economic hardships. The rights group urged the new administration to lift the ban on the Joint Awami Action Committee, arguing that these legal measures unfairly suppress freedom of speech and assembly. This crackdown follows months of regional unrest over inflation and public service issues, drawing significant criticism from international observers.
amharic: የአምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም በፀረ-ሽብር ህጎች የታሰሩ አክቲቪስቶችን መንግስት እንዲፈታ ጠይቋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቹ ድርጅት አዲሱ አስተዳደር በጋራ የህዝብ የድርጊት ኮሚቴ (JAAC) ላይ የጣለውን እገዳ እንዲያነሳና የመሰብሰብና የመናገር ነጻነትን እንዲያከብር አሳስቧል። ይህ በክልሉ የሚታየው የዜጎች መብት ገደብ ከኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ጋር ተያይዞ የሚነሱ ተቃውሞዎችን ተከትሎ አለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Amnesty International, mootummaan Kaashmiir kan Paakistaaniin bulchu, namoota gatii jireenyaa olka'e mormuun seera farra shororkeessummaan hidhaman akka gadhiisu gaafate. Dhaabbatichi mootummaa haaraa kanaan Komitee Gocha Uummataa Gamtaa (JAAC) irratti dhorkaa jiru akka kaasuufi mirga yaada ibsachuu fi walgahii nagaa akka kabaju jabeessee gaafate. Tarkaanfiin kun mormii diinagdee fi kaffaltii tajaajilaa waliin walqabatee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, rakkoo mirga namoomaa naannichaa irratti qeeqni addunyaa akka irratti xiyyeeffatu godheera.

title: What we know about the ground stop and what to do if you're affected
english: The US Federal Aviation Administration recently implemented a massive nationwide ground stop due to a critical communication failure, marking the largest flight disruption since 2001. Thousands of flights were canceled or delayed, leaving passengers stranded globally, though officials have confirmed there is no evidence of a cyber-attack. Travelers are being warned that air travel will likely face a ripple effect of delays and complications for several days as the system recovers.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል አቪዬሽን አስተዳደር በኮሙዩኒኬሽን መቋረጥ ምክንያት በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በረራዎችን አቁሞ ነበር። ይህ ክስተት ከ2001 ወዲህ ትልቁ የበረራ መስተጓጎል ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች በመሰረዛቸውና በመዘግየታቸው በዓለም ዙሪያ ያሉ ተጓዦች ተቸግረዋል። ባለስልጣናት ይህ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ስርዓቱ እስኪስተካከል ድረስ ለተወሰኑ ቀናት የበረራ መስተጓጎሎች ሊቀጥሉ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል።

Aangeyyonni miidhaan kun haleellaa saayberii akka hin taane mirkaneessaniiru, garuu sirni kun hanga deebi'ee qindaa'utti guyyoota muraasaaf tursiisiifi rakkoon balalii akka itti fufu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Hungary seizes $18m cash tied to ex-Orban-era minister in probe
english: Hungarian anti-corruption officials have confiscated approximately $18 million in hidden funds during a major investigation. The money was discovered stashed in various locations, including warehouses and buried in wooded areas. Authorities have linked these illicit funds to Miklós Seszták, a former government minister who served under Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.
amharic: የሃንጋሪ የፀረ-ሙስና ባለስልጣናት በምርመራ ወቅት ወደ 18 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ የተደበቀ ጥሬ ገንዘብ መያዛቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ገንዘቡ በተለያዩ መጋዘኖች ውስጥ ተደብቆ እና በጫካ ውስጥ ተቀብሮ የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቪክቶር ኦርባን የቀድሞ ሚኒስትር ሚክሎስ ሴስዝታክ ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳለው ተገልጿል።

Maallaqni kun iddoowwan garaagaraa fi bakkee bosonaa keessatti awwaalamee kan argame yoo ta'u, qorannoon kunis ministira duraanii mootummaa Viktar Oorbaan, Mikloos Seestaak waliin walqabatu.

title: Pacers hold off Knicks in NBA Cup thriller, Spurs rout Warriors
english: The Indiana Pacers defeated the New York Knicks 106-104 in a competitive NBA Cup game, significantly hurting the Knicks' chances of advancing to the next round. Despite a strong performance from Jalen Brunson, the Pacers relied on a balanced team effort to secure the win after pulling away in the final quarter. In other action, the San Antonio Spurs extended their winning streak by convincingly beating the Golden State Warriors.
amharic: የኢንዲያና ፔሰርስ ቡድን በኒውዮርክ ኒክስ ላይ 106 ለ 104 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ የኒክስን ቀጣይ ዙር የማለፍ ተስፋ አጨልሟል። የኒክስ ኮከብ ጃለን ብሩንሰን ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ ቢያደርግም፣ ፔሰርስ የተጠናከረ የቡድን ብቃት በማሳየት ማሸነፍ ችለዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሳን አንቶኒዮ ስፐርስ ቡድን ጎልደን ስቴት ዋሪየርስን በሰፊ ልዩነት በማሸነፍ የአሸናፊነት ጉዟቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: gareen Indiana Pacers tapha NBA Cup irratti New York Knicks 106-104n injifachuun carraa gareen Knicks gara dorgommii itti aanutti darbuu akka cufu godheera.
